license.privacy.offline_text: All document parsing, text extraction, OCR, visual pixel overlay diffing, and Local AI semantic inference run completely offline on your local machine. No document or text data is ever sent across the network.
license.privacy.telemetry_text: DiffAnyDoc contains no tracking scripts, analytics, or document telemetry. Your contracts, invoices, and source code stay 100% private and confidential.
license.privacy.updates_text: Network requests occur only when you explicitly click Check now for updates or Download & Set Up to fetch the optional local AI runtime and GGUF model to your disk. No document or personal data is ever transmitted.
license.terms.ai_text: Optional local AI semantic summaries and explanations run offline as automated decision-support aids. They do not constitute legal, financial, or compliance advice; users remain responsible for verifying all document changes.
license.terms.disclaimer_text: The Software is provided "AS IS", without warranty of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by law, the author shall not be liable for any direct or indirect damages arising from use of the software.
license.terms.grant_text: Licensor grants you a non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable license to install and run DiffAnyDoc on compatible devices for internal business or personal document comparison.
license.terms.ip_text: DiffAnyDoc is licensed, not sold. All source code, interfaces, visual diff algorithms, branding, and documentation remain the exclusive property of Mehmet Cagri Aksoy.
license.terms.restrictions_text: You may not reverse engineer, decompile, resell, sublicense, or bundle DiffAnyDoc into a competing product or hosted SaaS without explicit written permission.

boxSize.label: Box size

help.annotate.draw: Turn on Mark on page, then drag a box on a page and type a note. Use it for changes the tool did not find.
help.annotate.remove: Click × on a mark to remove it. The bin button removes all marks.
help.merge.all: The Copy menu applies all changes in one direction (A → B or B → A) and downloads the merged document.
help.merge.line: Each changed line has an arrow next to its number. → copies the left line to the right side, ← copies the right line to the left side.
help.modes.ai: ✨ AI View: Summarizes all differences locally on your machine, separates pure layout/position shifts from real wording or number changes, and lets you jump straight to each finding in Text or Pages view.
help.modes.compareMode: Layout Shifts vs. Text-Only: Moved paragraphs or columns are paired and numbered (#1, #2…) with position-shift badges (⇄ Δx/Δy) and vector arrows on the page. Turn on 'Ignore layout shifts (Text only)' to ignore shifted positions when the wording is identical.
help.modes.pages: Pages: the rendered pages with boxes on the changed text. Pick the box color with the color button.
help.modes.pagesTable: Pages (Tables / CSV): changed cells are outlined directly on the rendered table.
help.modes.report: Reports: export a self-contained HTML or PDF report with SHA-256 checksums and similarity stats.
help.modes.text: Text: both documents side by side, line by line. Only the changed words are highlighted.
help.modes.xray: X-Ray: both pages laid on top of each other. Removed ink is red, added ink is green.
help.modes.zoom: In Pages and X-Ray, zoom with the zoom buttons or Ctrl + mouse wheel. Drag to pan a zoomed page.
help.previewHint: Click any preview image to enlarge or shrink it.
help.start.ai: Local AI Analysis (✨ AI): Open the ✨ AI tab (or click '✨ Explain with AI' on any row) to run 100% offline semantic analysis on your CPU via llamafile and Qwen2.5-0.5B Instruct (Q2_K · ~215 MB default).
help.start.compareMode: Numbered Layout Matching (#1, #2, #3…): Moved or shifted text blocks are paired across both sides with numbered badges and connecting arrows instead of false delete/insert pairs. Turn on 'Ignore layout shifts (Text only)' to compare strictly the text/OCR content.
help.start.drop: Drop two files on the window, or click A and B to choose them. Two files dropped at once fill both sides.
help.start.ocr: Scanned pages and images are read with built-in OCR. Nothing leaves your machine.
help.start.preload: Reading starts as soon as you pick the first file, so the comparison is ready faster. Identical files are detected at once by checksum.
